library(thinkthen)

# build a question once. The band's middle is NA,
# "not sure": TRUE, FALSE, and NA for the send-back line
refund <- tt_question(decide = "Does the customer ask for a refund?",
  threshold = c(0.2, 0.8))
tt_decide(refund, c("Please refund my order. It arrived broken.",
  "Thanks for the quick help yesterday!",
  "I want to send this back."))
